events.speaker: arjun
events.name: Arjun Reddy
events.text: 180 * 3200 / 100 gives 576000 rupees monthly revenue. Aap bas teen ghar ki rasoi par chal rahe ho with 185 rupees cost per meal; yeh ek thin wrapper hai Dabbawala ka, aur switching cost zero hai kyunki koi bhi competitor Pune IT parks mein easily replace kar sakta hai. I am not convinced this is a company, merely a feature. Maybe.

events.speaker: ananya
events.name: Ananya Iyer
events.text: Pune ke IT parks mein 180 subscribers aur 64% renewal ke saath, aapka CAC kabhi recover hoga jab switching cost bilkul zero hai? Yeh thin wrapper kisi bhi Dabbawala se alag nahi lag raha, aur aapke teeno ghar ki rasoi se aage koi on-ground distribution plan nahi dikha. Maybe.
Vikram Sethia passed on this turn.

events.speaker: farah
events.name: Farah Merchant
events.text: 180 * 3200 gives 576000 rupees monthly revenue, par aapka Rs 85 food cost aur Rs 18 delivery cost milake Rs 103 per meal hai; agar aap 8% equity ke liye Rs 40 lakh maang rahe ho to yeh Rs 5 crore valuation bilkul unsustainable lagta hai kyunki aapke paas koi quality audit ya compliance trail nahi hai in teen home kitchens mein. Worst day par agar inme se ek kitchen band ho gaya ya aapka single supplier aata-sabzi de nahi paya, toh aapka entire supply chain collapse kar jayega aur inventory unpaid pile up ho jayegi.

Unit economics: revenue per meal is Rs 145 (3200/22). Food 85 + delivery 18 + packaging 6 = Rs 109, so Rs 36 gross margin per meal. CAC is Rs 900 via office WhatsApp groups. Kitchens are FSSAI registered.

events.speaker: arjun
events.name: Arjun Reddy
events.text: Aapka Rs 900 CAC payback 1.1 months hai, par yeh matlab nahi ki company defensible hai; yeh bas ek thin wrapper hai jiski switching cost bilkul zero hai kyunki koi bhi naya Pune IT park mein competitor easily replace kar sakta hai. Teen home kitchens par FSSAI registration ka koi moat nahi banata. I'm out because this is a services business disguised as SaaS with no scalable moat.

events.speaker: ananya
events.name: Ananya Iyer
events.text: Aapka 1.1 months ka CAC payback sunne mein toh kamaal hai, par yeh sirf office WhatsApp groups se aaya hai aur Pune ke IT parks ke baahar yeh distribution ka jugaad fail ho jayega. Teen home kitchens mein FSSAI registration trust toh dikhata hai, par ek supplier ka failure ya ek kitchen band hone par poora supply chain collapse kar jayega, aur yeh risk Rs 5 crore ki valuation par bilkul fit nahi baithta. Isliye main pass kar rahi hoon.

events.speaker: vikram
events.name: Vikram Sethia
events.text: Rs 900 CAC ka payback 1.1 months hai yeh sunke mera pet nahi bharta, par tu yeh bata ki 64% renewal ke baad month 3 se month 12 tak jo actual churn hoga uska hisaab tere paas hai ya bas 22 meals ka average nikal ke baith gaya hai? Mujhe lagta hai yeh Rs 5 crore ki valuation sirf 180 subscribers pe chipki hai jisme koi scalable moat nahi dikh raha.
Farah Merchant passed on this turn.

events.speaker: meera
events.name: Meera Kapoor
events.text: Beta, 900 divided by (36 * 22) gives 1.1 months ka CAC payback, par yeh tab tak accha lagta hai jab tak aap month 3 ka actual churn rate nahi batate. 64% renewal month 2 mein hai, aur mere liye DabbaDost jaisa Pune ka tiffin feature tabhi company banta hai jab customer teesri baar bina discount ke order kare, jo aapke paas abhi missing hai, isliye main maybe par hoon 5/10 confidence.
We have a 4th backup kitchen on standby and a weekly hygiene audit with photos. Renewal from month 3 onward is 88%. We are only in Pune for the next 12 months.

events.speaker: vikram
events.name: Vikram Sethia
events.text: 180 subscribers pe 5 crore ki valuation? Yeh toh dimaag ki dahi hai. 88% renewal month 3 se shuru, par tu 12 months mein Pune se nikalne wala hai, matlab yeh 1.1 months ka payback sirf ek saal ke liye hai. Jab Pune chhodega tab naya city kaunsa hai jahan yeh margin repeat hoga? Mujhe lagta hai yeh cash flow ka khel hai, par Pune ke IT parks ke baahar koi expansion plan nahi hai.

events.speaker: farah
events.name: Farah Merchant
events.text: Aapka Rs 900 CAC payback 1.1 months hai, par yeh 88% renewal month 3 se shuru hone ke baad bhi ek saal tak Pune IT parks tak hi simatna ek bada red flag hai kyunki aapke paas unpaid inventory ya working capital ka koi buffer nahi hai agar koi ek home kitchen band ho gaya. Mere hisaab se 180 subscribers par Rs 5 crore ki valuation bilkul unjustified hai, isliye main pass kar rahi hoon.

events.speaker: meera
events.name: Meera Kapoor
events.text: Beta, 88% renewal month 3 se shuru hona sunke acha laga, par 12 months mein bas Pune tak simatna mujhe darata hai kyunki repeat purchase wale IT professionals agar ek baar city badal gaye toh yeh 36 rupees margin wala tiffin band kar denge. Mujhe Pune ke IT parks se bahar ka koi retention data nahi dikh raha, isliye main pass kar rahi hoon.
Vikram Sethia didn't make a move.

verdict.one_liner: DabbaDost has a sharp 1.1-month payback in Pune, but with zero switching cost and three home kitchens, the sharks say it is a feature waiting to be copied, not yet a company.

votes.reason: Meera wants proof that customers reorder a third time without discounts, and sees no retention data beyond Pune IT parks once the founder leaves the city.
Arjun sees a thin wrapper over three home kitchens with no switching cost or scalable moat, calling it a services business rather than a company.
Ananya doubts that office WhatsApp distribution survives outside IT parks and worries a single kitchen or supplier failure would collapse the supply chain.
Vikram questions whether churn after month 3 was modelled rather than averaged, and sees a Rs 5 crore valuation resting on 180 subscribers in one city with no expansion plan.
Farah sees no compliance trail or working capital buffer across the three kitchens, so one kitchen failing would leave inventory unpaid, and she calls Rs 5 crore unjustified.

top_risks: Revenue is confined to Pune for the next 12 months, and the debate showed no evidence that the 88% renewal holds for customers in other cities.
The three partner home kitchens are a single point of failure, with no working capital buffer or documented supplier contingency beyond a standby fourth kitchen that has not been tested.
Zero switching cost and no proprietary moat mean a tiffin competitor can replicate the offer in Pune IT parks, and the Rs 36 per meal margin leaves little room to respond.
next_steps: Pull month-by-month churn for all 180 subscribers from month 3 through month 5 and show the cohort retention curve that supports the 88% figure.
Run a two-week test of the backup kitchen by moving one live delivery route onto it and recording lead time, quality, and any missed meals.
Map the cash needed to cover one month of food purchases across the three kitchens so the company can show how a single kitchen closure would be absorbed.
